issues.description: Path parameters are interpolated without URL encoding, so IDs containing '/', ':', '?', or '#' can misroute requests.
Network/timeout failures from httpx are neither retried nor wrapped in the client exception hierarchy.
Retry-After parsing only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date Retry-After values.
Pagination has no repeated-cursor guard, allowing an infinite loop if the server returns the same next_cursor.
Successful responses assume valid JSON and required fields, leaking JSONDecodeError, KeyError, or AttributeError instead of typed client errors.
BatchItemResult and ReviewResult do not validate Literal-backed status/verdict fields at runtime.
backoff_base and backoff_cap are not validated, so negative values can produce invalid sleep durations.
Package advertises type hints but does not ship a py.typed marker for downstream PEP 561 type checking.
Scripted mock responses bypass API-key validation, so tests can accidentally skip auth-header assertions on retry/failure paths.
